note: Hand-written, one row per canonical feature. This list is NOT derived by scanning the tree: a guard that only validates the features it already found passes cleanly on a project that has none of them. A row is `built` only when every named artefact exists AND the feature is genuinely finished. Rows that are `open` are expected to be unbuilt and do not fail the guard; a `built` row missing any artefact does.

Oaklands Reader design language, single guarded token source

Product-specific embed graphic, root master and served copy identical
About surface: provenance, licensing, non-affiliation, takedown route
Corpus importer with a fail-closed robots policy preflight
Full corpus captured and committed (1,063 articles)

Per-article attribution: revision, contributors, timestamp, licence

rows.title: Design-reference parity inventory and guard
rows.note: Nine hand-written reference screens, each pinned to a complete tuple (route, state, theme, viewport, scale) and digest-locked. The guard is proved red-then-green by eight mutations via --self-test.

rows.title: No element renders at browser defaults
Logic simulator built from the wiki's own documented parts
Master search on every page, with a full search surface behind it
rows.note: A plain GET form in the top bar of all 2,053 pages, so it works on the thousand prerendered article pages that never hydrate. Enter reaches /search/, which searches one index covering every article, alternate name, category, file and standing page — 2,053 entries, 119KB gzipped, fetched only on that page.

rows.title: Alternate names are real pages, not redirects
rows.note: 83 titles the source redirects now carry their own page with the same content and a canonical link to the primary article. 20 of their slugs needed disambiguating against an article differing only in capitalisation — the same collision that once silently overwrote four articles.

rows.title: Every referenced file has a page
rows.note: 836 file pages, 827 with an archived image and 9 recorded honestly as not archived, each listing the articles that use it.

rows.title: Money-making guide ranked by earnings and by difficulty
rows.note: 144 items from 446 sell-side price fields. Difficulty is computed from region, processing steps and obtainability and never from price, so high-value-low-effort is a finding rather than an artefact. Per-stud and per-item prices are ranked separately because they measure different things.
